description.en: Agent shelf desk for e-commerce sellers: track whether AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Meta Muse, Amazon Rufus, Perplexity) recommend your products for the questions buyers ask, who they pick instead and why, and a review queue of sourced listing fixes. The AirApp only records a person's decision on a fix; it never contacts a shopping agent or edits a store.
description.zh-CN: 面向电商卖家的智能体货架工作台：追踪 AI 购物智能体（ChatGPT、Gemini、Meta Muse、Amazon Rufus、Perplexity）在买家提问时是否推荐你的商品、推荐了谁、为什么，并把缺口变成有来源、需人审核的商品数据修改。AirApp 只记录人对修改的决定，从不访问购物智能体，也不改动店铺。

agentPrompts: Run this week's check: ask each buyer question in ChatGPT, Gemini and Meta Muse and record where we rank.
Which high-priority buyer questions are we missing from, and who gets recommended instead?
Turn this week's gaps into listing fixes with a source for every new value.
